title.suggested: Tom Allen Denies Challenging Coburn and O'Baldwin

summary.suggested: The Daily Missouri Democrat printed Tom Allen's disclaimer denying a telegraph report that he had challenged Joe Coburn for $5,000 and O'Baldwin for $1,000, saying he had no intention of doing so.

metadata.notes: masthead reads 'Daily Democrat, Tuesday Morning, May 16, 1871'

facts.fact: Allen publicly denied a telegraph report that he had challenged Joe Coburn for $5,000 and Ned O'Baldwin for $1,000
facts.quote: I have given no such challenge, and at the present writing have no intention of doing

notes: The current title and summary are wrong: this is Allen's 'Pugilistic Disclaimer', not a concert hall item. It denies the challenge reported in articles 431 and 432. The quote ends at 'doing' as printed.
